name: Power Grid Corporation of India Ltd.
about: Power Grid Corporation of India Limited, an electric power transmission utility, engages in the power transmission business in India and internationally. It operates in three segments: Transmission Services, Telecom Services, and Consultancy Services. As of 31 March 2026, the company owned and operated 184,960 circuit kilometers of transmission lines, and 291 substations with an aggregate transformation capacity of 624,016 mega volt amperes. It also provides telecom services that offer overhead optic fiber network services using optical ground wire on power transmission lines under the POWERTEL brand name, as well as lease lines, MPLS-VPN, data, infrastructure, and international long-distance services. verdict.label: Looks expensive
reasons: Price implies ~10% a year profit growth for 10 years, versus ~1% that history and analysts support (reverse DCF at 10.8% cost of equity).
High leverage (D/E 1.5x) raises risk; equity value is sensitive to interest costs.
Since 2023, most of the 13% a year price gain came from re-rating (PE 11 → 15), not earnings growth (1% a year).
